company.name: Bamboo
company.shortDescription: The social way for busy people to order pick-up meals from great restaurants around your office.
company.description:
Bamboo is a mobile payments app for cafes and restaurants in Dublin. Bamboo allows its users to preorder and prepay in advance and receive real-time notifications on the status of their orders - from when it's being prepared to when it is ready to collect.

Bamboo users automatically earn loyalty points with every order.
